question: Which athlete set a pole vault world record with a clearance of 6.28 m in Wanda Diamond League meeting in Stockholm (June 2025)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Armand Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Swedish pole vaulter **Armand "Mondo" Duplantis** set a new world record by clearing a height of **6.28 m**.
 
• This record-breaking performance occurred during the **Wanda Diamond League** meeting held in **Stockholm**, **Sweden**, in **June 2025**.
 
• By clearing **6.28 m**, Duplantis once again improved upon his own previous global mark, cementing his status as the greatest pole vaulter in history.
 
• The event, known as the **Bauhaus-Galan**, saw **Duplantis** compete in front of a home crowd at the historic **Stockholm Olympic Stadium**.
 
• The **6.28 m** clearance was achieved on his **first attempt** (or as specified in the meet details), demonstrating his unmatched consistency at extreme heights. ***Hence, the correct answer is Armand Duplantis.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Armand Duplantis:**
 
 
• Born on **November 10, 1999**, in **Lafayette, Louisiana, USA**, he holds dual citizenship but represents **Sweden** in international competitions.
 
• He won the **Gold Medal** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics** and the **Paris 2024 Olympics**, establishing a legacy of dominance.
 
• He was awarded the **World Athlete of the Year** title multiple times by **World Athletics**.
 
 
 
• **Renaud Lavillenie:**
 
 
• A **French** pole vaulter who held the world record of **6.16 m** from **2014 to 2020**.
 
• He won the **Olympic Gold** at the **2012 London Games** and remains one of the most decorated athletes in the sport's history.
 
 
 
• **Sam Kendricks:**
 
 
• An **American** pole vaulter and a **two-time World Champion** (**2017 and 2019**).
 
• He is known for his consistent podium finishes and for winning the **Bronze Medal** at the **2016 Rio Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **Thiago Braz:**
 
 
• A **Brazilian** athlete who rose to fame by winning the **Olympic Gold Medal** at the **2016 Rio Olympics** with a then-Olympic record of **6.03 m**.
 
• He also secured a **Bronze Medal** at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Wanda Diamond League:** This is an annual series of elite track and field athletic competitions, comprising **15** of the best invitational athletics meetings in the world. It was established in **2010** to replace the **IAAF Golden League**.
 
• **World Athletics:** The international governing body for the sport of athletics, which officially ratifies world records such as the **6.28 m** mark set by **Duplantis**.
 
• **Pole Vault Dynamics:** The sport involves using a flexible pole made of **carbon fiber** or **fiberglass**. World records can be set both **indoors** and **outdoors**, and since **2000**, World Athletics rules do not distinguish between the two for the overall world record.
